name: sii-4b-full-jeval
description: SII-Decision-4B BF16 full JEVal (11257 rows): 4 replicas on GPUs 0-3, length-bucketed batching, 100k token limit, resume-safe parts, scorer output. Trained full-rank checkpoint selected by validation.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
mkdir -p $R/logs/qz $R/runs/qz
cd $R
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

MODEL=$R/runs/qz/sii_4b_full/v1/checkpoint-276 \
INPUT=$R/data/jeval/sii_input.jsonl \
GOLD=$R/data/jeval/gold.json \
OUTDIR=$R/runs/qz/sii_4b_jeval \
SHARDS=8 GPUS_PER_REPLICA=1 BATCH_SIZE=8 MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=32768 \
MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=100000 RESUME=1 SCORE=1 \
bash harness/run_sii_eval.sh > $R/logs/qz/sii_4b_jeval.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
